tools.name: HubSpot reporting (meetings, marketing events, forms analytics)

dedicatedServiceKey.name: Alpha Website Funnel Reporting
dedicatedServiceKey.blockedProbe: legacy traffic analytics returned HTTP 403 despite reporting.full.read

tools.note: Existing held tokens produced the baseline traffic analytics, forms, submissions, marketing events, meetings and contacts. Post-merge AEO main run 36664885513 independently proved contacts, forms, marketing events, appointments, meeting links, 175 aggregate governed public/embedded bookings, and separate aggregate event authority in one scheduled runtime; the legacy traffic-analytics endpoint still returned 403. The same run audited the rolling integration cohort without writing contact rows: Program was populated on 94.35 percent and utm_source on 0.10 percent. First baseline read for 2026-09-01 to 09-27: 215,090 visits, 150,443 visitors, 378,684 pageviews, 4,926 leads, 62 customers, bounce 63 percent, 80 s per session. HubSpot has no per-URL data for WordPress pages; page-level paths remain GA4 territory.
